objective: Expose the shared HolyAgent CLI through typed, role-authorized native tool adapters in Pi codemode and the supported Claude integration.
scope: Shared typed command catalog/Effect dispatch and trusted-role authorization; Pi native registration and Claude host adapter, conformance tests and focused docs.
constraints: Work only /workspace/work/holyagent-034-tools from accepted c3c93510; scratch /workspace/work/034. Read AGENTS.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md, integration role sections as needed; /workspace/work/034/runtime-map.md, host-contracts.md, mcp-capabilities.md are accepted research, their limits matter. User authorized0.3.4 using Intents/Terra agents. Root selected explicit schema-decoded command adapters reusing existing Effect dispatch rather than generic unrestricted shell/argv. No new dependencies; updater only. No real pi launches/live model calls/user-PC writes/account/admin/publish/VCS/statewrites or extra subagents. Temporary fixtures and deterministic SDK/mock sessions allowed.

Native adapters must use same strict schemas/domain/errors/observable results as CLI, preserve CLI compatibility, and support explicit cancellation through Effect interruption. Derive role from trusted host/session context, never arguments/default root. Enforce root/specialist policy BOTH inventory/registration AND execution including codemode/nested calls. Default deny unknown commands/roles. Explicit allowed read/search specialist capabilities only with role-compatible tool policy. Mutating state/VCS/setup/hook interfaces cannot be reached by specialists through aliases or indirect calls. A local scheduling reservation is not authorization.

Inventory ALL current COMMANDS (research baseline35): every identity has native supported schema+adapter OR explicit unsupported reason/capability. rg/fd raw passthrough, stdio browser-server, hooks, setup/VCS interactive bits must be deliberately classified. Do not hide unsupported functionality or call a generic argv tool a full typed solution. Add contract tests comparing inventory to COMMANDS to catch future handoff command. Sibling branch adds handoff/operational flags; do not cherry-pick or edit sibling, root merges later and assigned final coverage will require it.

Use a narrow shared Effect dispatch seam if extraction needed; no rewrite of CLI or broad architecture. Claude has different native tool APIs than Pi; establish actual supported adapter/capabilities (likely MCP if repo already supports protocol) and test sourced host-specific authority, no forged identity parameter/env trust claim. If any required authorization cannot be enforced by available Claude host adapter, stop with compact evidence/options before unsafe implementation, implement unaffected shared/Pi work. Shared behavior adapted to both harnesses, not Pi-only silent omission.

Pi uses built-in MCP/codemode locked1.5.0; no pi-mcp-to-tool dependency. Real SDK harmless mock tests preferred to fake-only assumptions for permission and role-filter execution. Tools must be discoverable/callable in codemode and respond accurately to cancellation/error. Do not implement wait/aliases/routing/search/scoped-skills in this slice: separate work. Own extension.ts final native wiring here. Avoid generated dist edits; final build root-coordinated.

Run meaningful focused regression/conformance tests and changed-scope type/lint/fmt via mise; install frozen --ignore-scripts perworktree. No full build/verify yet. Toolchain env MISE_DATA_DIR=/workspace/work/tools/mise/data MISE_CACHE_DIR=/workspace/work/tools/mise/cache MISE_STATE_DIR=/workspace/work/tools/mise/state MISE_CONFIG_DIR=/workspace/work/tools/mise/config PATH=/workspace/work/tools/mise/bin:/workspace/work/tools/bun/bin:$PATH. Use /workspace/work/cancel-supervisor.py for orphan-reaping process fixtures as needed.

Report tooling failures with reproduction/impact and acceptance. Keep working until requested code/checks done or genuine host contract blocks safe progress, then stop. Diff /workspace/work/034/native-tools.diff and JSON /workspace/work/034/native-tools-report.json shape {status,changed_paths,checks:[{command,exit}],blockers,notes,evidence:[{key,support}]}; exact keys. Final under350words, detailed logs external.

criteria.text: Every CLI command has an explicit typed native capability or justified unsupported classification
Trusted root and specialist authorization is enforced at inventory and indirect execution without weakening CLI validation
Supported Pi and Claude adapters expose accurate results errors and cancellation with host-specific conformance evidence
Focused regression checks pass and changes stay within native tooling scope
